olivia: Help — new user on macOS Big Sur following quickstart got a 401 on their first SDK call. They said they copied the API key from Console.
raj: 401 usually means key invalid or old key cached. Are they using a credential helper or env var?
olivia: They used the node quickstart and I think they set REDWOOD_API_KEY in their shell. But their git credential helper shows an entry with a different key.
jo: On mac, the osxkeychain can store old creds. Suggest clearing with: 
```
# remove stored credential
printf "protocol=https\nhost=api.redwood.example\n" | git credential-osxkeychain erase
```
olivia: Tried that, then they updated env var and retried. Now they get 403 with code=POLICY_RESTRICTED. Console shows workspace active and billing present.
support-bot: (automated) Logs for trace_id=tr_MN456 -> 403, policy=needs_org_admin, billing_required=false
raj: Huh. billing_required=false but policy says needs_org_admin. That matches some SSO invite edge cases where the invite flow doesn't assign admin role to first API key.
tara: I saw something similar: invite-created workspaces sometimes require the owner to complete the "Org details" flow before API access is granted. We should surface that in our quickstart troubleshooting.
jo: Action items: devex -> add credential helper troubleshooting and note about SSO/invite admins; infra -> investigate policy inference mismatch (ticket POLICY-1432); sdk -> ensure TLS/auth errors are not masked by retry behavior.
olivia: I'll send the support reply: "If you used an invite/SSO, please complete Console > Workspace > Org details and Billing. Also clear any stale credential helpers on macOS and retry with REDWOOD_API_KEY exported. If still blocked, reply with trace_id=tr_MN456."
raj: tagging @ben to own infra ticket.
support-bot: (automated) Created SUPPORT-8925 referencing trace_id=tr_MN456 and POLICY-1432.
jo: Quick doc snippet I'll add to quickstart: 
"If you get 401 on macOS: check for stored credentials in Keychain or git credential helper; run the erase command above, then export REDWOOD_API_KEY and retry. If you move from SSO invite, complete Org details in Console to enable API keys."
